citation: Sugimoto T, et al. Physiol Rep 2020;8:e14528
protocol: Cycle ergometer, 40 min continuous at 60% VO2peak (S-EX arm) vs 2 x 20 min with 20 min rest (R-EX); blood glucose, lactate, HR, MAP at pre, post 0, 10, 20, 30 min
population: 20 healthy young men, 21.0 +/- 0.4 y, 64.0 +/- 2.0 kg, VO2peak 45.9 +/- 1.0 mL/kg/min
note: Both arms are single-session bouts of 40 min total work at the same intensity; values are mean +/- SEM (glucose in mg/dL); no sample during exercise.
